text: Cultivate their minds, inspire their little hearts, raise their wishes. Fix their attention upon great and glorious objects. Root out every little thing. Weed out every meanness. Make them great and manly. Teach them to scorn injustice, ingratitude, cowardice, and falsehood. Let them revere nothing but religion, morality, and liberty.
author: John Adams
reference: Familiar Letters of John Adams and His Wife Abigail Adams
locator: Letter 96, John Adams to Abigail Adams, 15 April, 1776
